event_rule: conflict events only. State-based: one event per conflict EPISODE in which the country's government is a primary party (side A or side B), dated at the episode start date (start_date2); a conflict id counts once per episode start. One-sided: one event per actor that is the country's government, dated 1 January of the first year of each unbroken run of active years. kind = conflict. No cause, no effect, no label.
